suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as disease complication sequela. Require documented acne vulgaris/acne conglobata and separately documented acne scarring. Do not infer scarring from active acne alone. Do not substitute the existing painful/unstable-scars identity unless those scar characteristics are independently documented. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Independent diagnoses of Acne Vulgaris / Acne Conglobata and Acne Scarring
Chronology compatible with the bounded source proposition
Assessment of shared risk factors, reverse direction, treatment effects, and other competing causes

Resolution of the publication guard: Require documented acne vulgaris/acne conglobata and separately documented acne scarring. Do not infer scarring from active acne alone. Do not substitute the existing painful/unstable-scars identity unless those scar characteristics are independently documented.
